name: Mobis Parts America PDC - Ontario CA

fieldNotes.site: Mobis Parts America West Coast PDC at 1900 S Rochester Ave, Ontario CA — confirmed by web research (BBB, D&B, Panjiva). Large single warehouse building in a multi-tenant Inland Empire industrial park bordered by a freeway on the east; other tenants share the complex (e.g. 'Spartan' signage on the building).
fieldNotes.truckGate: false — the truck court / dock yard runs off S Rochester Ave via an OPEN driveway. Street View (2021-02, 2025-01) shows no barrier arm, no sliding gate, and no checkpoint pinch-point at the road. Standard open multi-tenant business-park access.
fieldNotes.guardShack: false — no staffed booth at the truck court entrance. A small structure mid-yard reads as an office/storage cabin, not a gate guard booth.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: false — no gate at all, so no remote check-in implied.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: South dock face of the Mobis building carries a long bank of dock doors with trailers backed in; counted ~46, placing it in the 25-50 band. Door count flagged as an honest overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Row of parked trailers in the truck court between buildings — modest drop activity, 10-25 stalls. Not a dedicated drop yard, so dropYard = false.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The shared truck court drive is long enough to stack 3+ trucks between the buildings.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Urban — dense Ontario/Inland Empire logistics corridor, wall-to-wall warehouses and a freeway alongside.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: false — Mobis occupies one building; the surrounding warehouses are separate properties/tenants, not one campus.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: false — a single south dock bank serves both ship and receive.
fieldNotes.railServed: false — no rail spur into the property.
fieldNotes.geofence: Center 34.0402,-117.5531 on the Mobis building; perimeter box encloses the building and its shared south truck court.
